transcript: Robot: Hello, what is your name? Man: My name is Vikas. Robot: How old are you? Man: I am 22. Robot: 22 nahi, I am 22 years old bolo. [Don't say 22, say 'I am 22 years old'.] Man: I am 22 years old. Robot: Where are you from? Man: I am live Jharkhand. Robot: I am from Jharkhand bolo dheere se. [Say 'I am from Jharkhand' slowly.] Man: I am from Jharkhand. Robot: Bahut acha. [Very good.] Man: Mujhe English achi nahi aati. [I don't know English well.] Robot: Pata hai, isiliye to main hoon ek AI teacher aur isiliye English Seekho app hai. [I know, that's why I am an AI teacher and that's why there is the English Seekho app.] Man: Teachers mehnge hote hain. [Teachers are expensive.] Robot: Trial sirf ’1 ka, chai se bhi sasta. Lakhon log English Seekho app par seekh rahe hain. Lekin seekhne ke saath practice bhi kar rahe hain. App par experts ke chhote 5 minute ke videos hain, aur Hindi mein samjha kar English seekhate hain. Aur main 24 ghante hoon. Jo seekha, woh mere saath bolkar practice karo. Galat bologe main sudhaar doongi, kabhi hasungi nahi, kabhi judge nahi karoongi. Roz sirf 15 se 20 minute. [Trial is just 1 rupee, cheaper than tea. Lakhs of people are learning on the English Seekho app. But along with learning, they are also practicing. The app has short 5-minute videos by experts, teaching English by explaining in Hindi. And I am available 24 hours. Practice speaking what you learned with me. If you speak incorrectly, I will correct you, I will never laugh, I will never judge. Just 15 to 20 minutes daily.] Man: Aur main kaise judun? [And how do I join?] Robot: English Seekho app download karo, 15 din mein farq dikhega. Shuru karte hain aaj se. [Download the English Seekho app, you will see a difference in 15 days. Let's start today.] Voiceover: Install now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo. [Click on install now and download the English Seekho app now.]
on_screen_text: WHAT IS YOUR NAME, MY NAME IS VIKAS, HOW OLD ARE YOU, I AM 22, I AM 22 YEARS OLD BOLO, I AM 22 YEARS OLD, WHERE ARE YOU FROM, I AM LIVE JHARKHAND, I AM FROM JHARKHAND BOLO DHEERE SE, I AM FROM JHARKHAND, BAHUT ACHA, MUJHE ENGLISH ACHI NAHI AATI, PATA HAI, AI TEACHER, TEACHERS MEHNGE HOTE HAIN, TRIAL SIRF ’1 KA, CHAI SE BHI SASTA, LAKHON LOG, PRACTICE, EXPERTS, 5 MINUTE VIDEOS, HINDI MEIN SAMJHA KAR, SEEKHATE HAIN, 24 GHANTE, PRACTICE, SUDHAAR DOONGI, KABHI HASUNGI NAHI, KABHI JUDGE NAHI KAROONGI, ROZ SIRF 15-20 MINUTE, ENGLISH, SEEKHO APP, 15 DIN MEIN, FARQ DIKHEGA, SHURU KARTE HAIN, AAJ SE, English Seekho, DISCLAIMER...
summary: A man on a metro train interacts with an AI robot teacher who corrects his English grammar. The robot introduces the 'English Seekho' app, highlighting its 1-rupee trial, short Hindi-explained lessons, and 24/7 AI practice partner. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
